description: Static beta_zzz(0;0,0) and alpha_zz(0) of LiH (HF, quadratic response, z only) at one rung (protocol 1e-4, k 6). The one beta row (index 0) is A=z, B=C=dipole_z, freq_b=freq_c=0 -- the static beta_zzz; LiH is polar, so it is a large number (~3e2 au) rather than a symmetry zero. Reference: RelWithDebInfo, Pthreads, ArmPL, 1 rank x 7 threads, dd (Neoverse-N1), 2026-09-27, on 0ecf076f3 plus the FD relative gate, wall 30 s; the z leg stops in 9 iterations at bsh 4.7e-4 (12 under the old absolute gate), and against the previous reference alpha_zz moved -9.9e-4 (22.155842 -> 22.154852) and beta_zzz -0.015 % (315.7768 -> 315.7309). beta rtol 0.01 (10x the run-to-run spread); the 1e-6 scripted-test value was 315.595 au. Tier: registered `long` (42 s), a deviation from the plan's CI tier -- the deck at `l 80.0` measured 50 s and at `l 50.0` (same beta_zzz to 0.08 %) 42 s, and a static beta cannot be cut further: it needs the z FD leg and one VBC solve.
